preconditions.description: The length of str1 must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of str2 must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in str1)
preconditions.description: All characters in str1 must be lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in str2)
preconditions.description: All characters in str2 must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in stdout for c in str1)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain all characters of str1 as a subsequence.

postconditions.expression: all(c in stdout for c in str2)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain all characters of str2 as a subsequence.
The length of the output string must be at most the sum of the lengths of str1 and str2.
